Play the live rebuild

What changed

A court-centered arena, direct ball/shooter choices, four editable plays, inferred screens and rolls, automatic passing, optional playable coaching, short contextual feedback and immediate rematches. Historical data and one-player-per-position drafts are preserved.

Findings and resolutions

high · fixed

UX01 — Automatic passing silently replaces the ball handler

Expected: Selecting player 4 and choosing automatic delivery preserves player 4.

Observed: Local browser reproduced starter becoming 0 (player 1).

Fix: Direct always-visible handler action; preserve starter in all delivery changes.

Reproduce / verify

Draft five → Passing options → starter 4 → Use automatic passing.

old src/main.jsx: useAutomaticPlay

Covered by the rebuilt-game browser and mechanics checks.

high · fixed

Expected: Draw, run, watch and retry in one court-sized view.

Observed: Large heading, toolbar and side form compete; result/actions require scrolling at phone sizes.

Fix: Viewport-fitted arena with HUD, court and persistent action dock.

UX04 — Draft identity is overwhelmed by statistics and repeated status

Expected: Quickly compare basketball strengths and pick a legend for an open slot.

Observed: Large introductory copy, repeated position information and five stat columns before every pick.

Fix: Jersey cards with compact strengths; details on demand; filled positions compact.

Expected: All five levels have practical winning approaches with normal randomness.

Observed: Existing full-ladder UI check forces every outcome; only single-possession ordinary UI evidence.

medium · fixed

UX06 — Screen movement cannot continue into a roll

Expected: Route through a screen then to the rim plants briefly and continues.

Observed: Only final route endpoint can plant; continuing the drawing removes that pick.

Fix: Infer an intermediate screen point with approach, plant and roll phases.

Reproduce / verify

Extend a setter route beyond its screen endpoint.

Covered by the rebuilt-game browser and mechanics checks.

high · fixed

UX07 — Hover motion makes the next Play button jitter

Expected: After practice or a result, Play remains a stable click target.

Observed: The old hover translation oscillated when a changed label left the pointer at its edge; the walkthrough could not click Play.

Fix: Keep primary action geometry stationary on hover; retain color and shadow feedback.

Reproduce / verify

Complete warm-up, click Start challenge, then click Play from the same pointer position.

src/style.css .primary:hover; tests/browser/game.spec.js optional coaching

Covered by the rebuilt-game browser and mechanics checks.

high · fixed

UX08 — Small-phone controls extend beyond the viewport

Expected: All main actions fit at 320 px without horizontal scrolling or clipping.

Observed: Intrinsic grid sizing widened the court and dock; the ladder also exceeded its track.

Fix: Give the arena an explicit minmax(0,1fr) column, constrain court sizing and tighten only the smallest ladder spacing.

Reproduce / verify

Draft five, use 320×640 viewport, inspect each control bounding box.

src/style.css arena grid and compact ladder

Covered by the rebuilt-game browser and mechanics checks.

medium · fixed

UX09 — A basic cut receives an incidental planted screen

Expected: The Cut starter teaches movement; Screen teaches a pick.

Observed: A stationary template teammate occupied the cut’s path, implicitly screening without that being the play’s lesson.

Fix: Spread inactive teammates away from the cut. Screen and Roll starters still create actual contact.

Reproduce / verify

Inspect default Cut plan and actual contact events.

src/game/playbook.js; tests/rebuild.test.js cuts versus screens

Covered by the rebuilt-game browser and mechanics checks.

medium · fixed

UX10 — Close-range shot arc can clip above the court

Expected: The ball stays visible from release through the rim.

Observed: Full-speed footage showed an oversized close-range arc reaching the top boundary.

Fix: Use a bounded 40-unit arc, preserving one visible ball and the rim landing.

Reproduce / verify

Run a close-range pick and roll and inspect the shot phase.

src/components/Court.jsx shot arc

Covered by the rebuilt-game browser and mechanics checks.

Actual playthroughs

These recorded runs started with fresh drafts and used visible mouse or touch controls. No state injection, forced wins or random-function replacement. Playback ran at normal speed; decisions were automated, so these durations are not human session-time estimates.

RunPossessionsRematchesElapsedResult
desktop21183 sAll five beaten · 0 page errors
touch20078 sAll five beaten · 0 page errors

Complete shot outcomes, rosters, screenshots and recording paths are in walkthroughs.json. Browser regression runs additionally complete the ladder with ordinary randomness.

Fairness check

120 different valid drafted teams; 361 distinct identities. 120 simulated ladders completed, with a median of 22 possessions, a 90th percentile of 31, and 1.02 average rematches. The simulation measures the model, not player satisfaction.

OpponentSimple strategyBucket chanceStanding stillRound win chance
1cut74%34%89%
2cut72%31%87%
3screen72%26%87%
4roll72%31%86%
5screen68%20%81%

120 seeded random valid drafts, predeclared strategies by opponent; no best-play oracle. Equivalent independent bucket/miss distributions include interception risk. Full method and every outcome: balance.json. A human pacing estimate is roughly 5–10 minutes including drafting and time to think; it has not been measured in human playtests.

Control sweep

Verified: all five draft positions and blocked repeats; player details/search; ball and shot choice; all four plays; Move/Draw/Pass; undo; clear versus reset; direct and manual delivery; optional practice; ordinary makes/misses/interceptions; retry/advance/victory; saved-game resume; sound preference; keyboard edits; modal Escape; new-draft cancel/confirm. Current tests are recorded in VALIDATION.md.

Intentional limits: source links are validated as attributed URLs without clicking every off-site record; sound preference and cue invocation are tested but subjective loudness is not automatically judged. Physical phones, Safari/Firefox and an independent human usability review remain untested. Moving-screen fouls, rebounds and detailed contact physics are outside this arcade model.

QA reference: Agent Team Kit. No hooks, hosted feedback backend or release pipeline were installed. Broad critique stayed local; the live site receives a targeted post-release smoke check.
